title: Benny Shares His Carrots

intro.text: Hi friends! I'm Benny the bunny! I have a story for you. Are you ready? Hop, hop, hooray!
intro.speaker: character

outro.text: Thank you for listening, friends! Remember to share. Bye bye!
outro.speaker: character

moralRhyme: Sharing shows how much we care!

youtube.title: Benny Shares His Carrots 🥕 A Story About Sharing for Kids
youtube.description:
Benny the bunny finds a big basket of carrots — but will he share with his friend Bella? A warm, funny story about sharing and friendship, with questions for your little one to answer along the way.
#kidsstories #sharing #bedtimestories #toddlers #moralstories

lines.text: Benny the bunny loved carrots more than anything.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Crunch, crunch, munch! Yummy carrots!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Hop, hop, hooray!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: One sunny morning, Benny found a big basket of carrots.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Wow! Ten carrots, all for me!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Then Bella the bear came by. Her tummy was rumbling.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Hello Benny! Those carrots look so yummy.
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: What should Benny do? Share his carrots, or keep them all?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes! Sharing is kind! Let's see what Benny does.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: But Benny held the basket tight.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: No! These carrots are all mine!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Bella walked away with a sad, sad face.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Benny ate one carrot. Then two. Then three.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Hmm. Eating alone is not much fun.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Benny looked at the big basket. His heart felt heavy.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: I miss my friend Bella.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Suddenly, Benny had an idea!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Carrots taste better with a friend!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Hop, hop, hooray!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Benny hopped to Bella as fast as he could.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Bella! Let's share my carrots!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Bella smiled the biggest smile.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Thank you, Benny! You are a great friend!
lines.speaker: friend

lines.text: Crunch, crunch, munch! Yummy carrots!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: What color are Benny's carrots?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes! Orange carrots! Great job!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Sharing made two friends very, very happy.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Hop, hop, hooray!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Should we share with our friends? Say yes!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Yes! Sharing is caring! High five!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Benny learned something very important!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Sharing makes everyone happy.
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Share, share, it's only fair!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Sharing shows how much we care!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Can you say it with me?
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Share, share, it's only fair!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Sharing shows how much we care!
lines.speaker: character

lines.text: Hooray! You did it!
lines.speaker: character
